description_snippet: TD and E-TD - PM-Manager At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. Product Manager Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Product Manager with 12+ years of experience to lead the strategy, roadmap and end-to-end lifecycle of digital products and platforms. The role requires strong product management expertise, business acumen, stakeholder leadership and the ability to translate market, user and business needs into scalable, value-driven product solutions. The ideal candidate should have experience applying value management principles to shape business cases, prioritize investments, define measurable outcomes and track realized value, while keeping product strategy, user needs and product lifecycle ownership as the core focus. The candidate will bring deep experience in at least one sector or business domain, with life sciences/healthcare knowledge considered a strong advantage, and will work closely with business, engineering, architecture, data and design teams to deliver user-centric products with measurable business impact. Key Responsibilities: Define and drive the product vision, strategy and roadmap for digital products and platforms, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs and measurable outcomes. Lead product discovery and problem framing by combining user insights, market understanding, business context and data-driven analysis to identify high-value opportunities. Translate strategic priorities into product plans, feature direction and release roadmaps, balancing business value, user impact, feasibility, risks and dependencies. Partner with business stakeholders, engineering, architecture, data and UX teams to shape solutions
